main source of identification: Condition on measured common causes of treatment and outcome
works best when: The important confounders are observed and measured well

main source of identification: A measured mediator carries the treatment effect
works best when: Treatment affects outcome only through the mediator, and mediator-outcome confounding is controlled
main risk: Direct effects or mediator-outcome confounding violate the design

main source of identification: An external variable shifts treatment but has no direct path to outcome
works best when: The instrument is relevant, independent, and satisfies exclusion
main risk: The instrument affects the outcome through another path

main source of identification: Treatment probability jumps at a cutoff in a running variable
works best when: Units cannot precisely manipulate the cutoff and the outcome is smooth around it
main risk: Sorting around the cutoff or unrelated discontinuities

main source of identification: A treated group changes after treatment relative to a comparison group
works best when: The groups would have followed parallel trends without treatment
main risk: The comparison group is not a credible counterfactual trend
